problems.title: Trace 1. Multiple spaces
problems.description:
The input line contains multiple spaces.
Use split() and fill input1, input2, a, b, and output.

Example table:
| input1 | input2 | a | b | output |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3 | 5 | 3 | 5 | 0 |
problems.code:
a, b = map(int, input().split())
print(a + b)

problems.title: Trace 2. Name and age
problems.description:
Read name and age from one line. Convert age to int.
Print in the format name:age. Fill the table.

Example table:
| name | age | output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Amy | 12 | 0 |
problems.code:
name, age = input().split()
age = int(age)
print(%s:%d % (name, age))

problems.title: Reverse 1. Find the age
problems.description:
You are given the output format name:age.
Find the missing age. (number only)

problems.title: Trace 3. Two-line mixed input
problems.description:
Line1 contains a name. Line2 contains two integers.
Compute x + y and print name with the sum. Fill the table.

Example table:
| name | x | y | output |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Amy | 1 | 1 | 0 |
problems.code:
name = input().strip()
x, y = map(int, input().split())
print(name, x + y)

problems.title: Trace 4. split(' ') effect
problems.description:
The input contains two spaces between values.
Using split(' ') creates an empty value. Fill values and length.

Example table:
| value1 | value2 | value3 | len |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ... | ... | ... | 3 |
